## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem, what changes and why. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Scope and evidence

Describe affected learning activities, scoring/evidence, execution, AI behavior or configuration. State remaining limitations. Do not post vulnerability details here; follow SECURITY.md for private handling.

## Validation

List exact commands and actual results, including skipped or unrun checks. Identify real-model vs fake-provider and real-container vs mock coverage. Documentation-only changes can state that application checks were not applicable and describe the documentation review performed.

## Actual screenshots, if relevant

Add sanitized captures of the real UI for visible changes, with short captions. Remove this section if it does not apply. Do not invent screenshots or use placeholder screens as evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I checked the published project license and have permission to contribute the included material.
- [ ] This change preserves the local-only boundary, or clearly documents a separately reviewed boundary change.
- [ ] Deterministic evidence remains distinct from advisory AI and mock execution.
- [ ] I reviewed changed files and attachments for secrets and private learner data.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests are updated, or the reason they are not needed is explained above.
